scientific_integrity.domain: All primes p and integers a>=1; second Schemmel totient iterate sums D_2(p^a).
scientific_integrity.limitations: No classification for integers with more than one distinct prime factor, or for m other than 2. Independent assessment absent; unlocated equivalent historical proof remains possible.
scientific_integrity.priority_note: Pre-existing deficiency theorems at 3 and 5 are acknowledged, not claimed as novel.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Local CRT count; odd-input lower bound and sharp fiber; first three iterates; finite geometric sums.
scientific_integrity.proved: Exact formula at p=2,3,5; strict abundance for all p>=7, exact minimum surplus 2 and minimizers 7,11,17; no perfect prime powers.

title: Prime-power classification and sharp surplus for iterated Schemmel totient sums
